summary: The exact candidate is accurately scoped as test-only hardening and a limitation report, not an implementation fix. Its six-case mocked relay regression passes on both recorded base and candidate. Direct CPU and AMD GPU NGRAM reconstruction are blocked by missing operators in the pinned loaded sglang-kernel 0.4.6.post1 egg. The original overlap-spec roadmap remains unresolved.

tests.what_was_measured: Exact candidate revision: all six mocked relay, grammar, acceptance-width, empty-batch, and malformed-width cases passed.
The exact candidate test copied outside the checkout also passed all six cases on recorded base 358c163, proving no failing-before implementation regression.
Direct CPU NGRAM reconstruction failed because the pinned native namespace lacks reconstruct_indices_from_tree_mask_cpu.
Direct assigned-GPU NGRAM reconstruction dispatch failed because the pinned native namespace lacks reconstruct_indices_from_tree_mask.
Adjacent real-GPU speculative KV-index grid passed 3 cases against an independent Python reference; this does not prove NGRAM serving.

gpu_evidence: One AMD Instinct MI350X was visible. HIP dispatch reached the missing NGRAM operator, and the independent neighboring KV-index numerical-reference grid passed 3/3.
remaining_counterexamples: The candidate has no implementation/native change and its complete added relay regression already passes on the recorded base.
End-to-end overlap NGRAM cannot execute because the pinned loaded sglang-kernel 0.4.6.post1 egg lacks reconstruct_indices_from_tree_mask_cpu and reconstruct_indices_from_tree_mask.

Combined top-k/page-size serving, memory over-allocation optimization, optional verify synchronization, penalty support, universal worker parity, high-throughput specialization, EP/DeepEP, PD disaggregation, and a separate plan stream remain unimplemented or unqualified.
No independent EAGLE/NGRAM model-accuracy, attention-backend matrix, distributed DP/EP/DeepEP, PD-disaggregation, or LoRA serving result is provided.
Passing mocked relay and adjacent speculative KV-index tests do not prove the NGRAM serving contract or the full overlap-spec roadmap.
remaining_limitations: The pinned native dependency lacks both NGRAM reconstruction operators, and the prepared environment supplies no native rebuild command or replacement artifact.
Only one AMD Instinct MI350X was available; NVIDIA/CUDA, multi-GPU, multi-node, EP/DeepEP, and PD-disaggregation architectures were unavailable.
No qualified EAGLE/NGRAM semantic model weights or LoRA serving model were available; the tiny Llama fixture can validate transport only.
